title: Akers v. J. B. Sedberry — face-to-face lapse
shortTitle: Akers v. J. B. Sedberry — face-to-face lapse
summary: An offer made during a conversation ordinarily expires with that conversation.
notes: An employee offered to resign, the employer did not accept during the meeting, and later tried to do so. The reported ruling favored the employee. The example concerns the context-dependent duration of an offer, not a ban on making oral offers that expressly remain open.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 239–240. Open assigned page 239.
